what_it_does: BOER addresses how to run multiple AI models on a single GPU more efficiently. When multiple models share a GPU, they interfere with each other and waste compute resources. BOER combines two GPU sharing technologies—MPS (Multi-Process Service) which shares one GPU partition across tasks, and MIG (Multi-Instance GPU) which divides a GPU into separate partitions. By stacking these technologies intelligently and using optimization algorithms, BOER decides which models to run together, how to partition the GPU, and how to distribute work across the shared resources.
